Lore_Notes: Commander Halvorn mobilizes the full Imperial army for a major territorial push. Players must choose to assist the Empire, sabotage the march, or stay neutral — each path permanently alters Ironveil faction reputation.

Trigger_Condition: Random trigger, 5% chance per hour in Void Rift zone
Lore_Notes: Reality fractures violently across the Void Rift. Dimensional entities pour through temporary tears. Players who survive the full 6-hour storm receive the Void Touched permanent buff.
The Obsidian Syndicate runs coordinated heists across the Neon Sprawl. Players with Syndicate rep Neutral+ can participate. Rewards scale with heist difficulty tier chosen.

Trigger_Condition: First week of each seasonal cycle
Lore_Notes: The Root Covenant's sacred gathering. All factions observe an unofficial ceasefire during the festival week. Rare nature-based modules and cosmetics available only during this event.
All faction leaders convene in the Citadel for peace negotiations. Players serve as security, informants, or saboteurs. Councilor Zephyra Nox's true agenda is partially revealed during this event.

Trigger_Condition: Random trigger — 8% chance per 4 hours in Neon Sprawl
Lore_Notes: All power and surveillance systems in the Neon Sprawl fail simultaneously. Syndicate enforcers lose visibility. Drifters celebrate openly. The blackout reveals hidden infrastructure inaccessible during normal operation.

Trigger_Condition: Second week of every two seasonal cycles
Lore_Notes: Every major merchant faction and player trader gathers at Port Mira for the Miraverse's largest commerce event. Limited-edition items appear. Prices fluctuate wildly based on player trading activity.

The Ironveil Empire's structured combat tournament held in Ironspire's war arena. Solo and squad brackets. Top performers earn invitations to Commander Halvorn's inner war council as temporary advisors.

Trigger_Condition: Find all 3 Void Anchor Stones + Void Walker rep Honored+
Lore_Notes: Sable leads a secret ritual at the Rift Core to attempt stabilizing a portion of the Void. Players who participate witness a vision of the previous Miraverse iteration. Extremely limited access.

Trigger_Condition: Environmental trigger — heavy player combat in REG009
Lore_Notes: Intense combat in the Shattered Peaks triggers structural instability, causing a chain avalanche that reshapes the terrain temporarily, closes some paths, and opens others. Buried caches sometimes surface.

Citizens of the Verdant Republic vote on council representatives. Players can campaign for candidates, expose corruption, or manipulate results. Outcome affects Republic questline options for the following season.

When a player's Syndicate reputation becomes Hostile, the Syndicate sends escalating waves of enforcers. Surviving the Purge and escaping converts rep to Neutral. Black Jade leads the final wave if rep remains Hostile for 72 hours.

Assembling all Mireth Relics in the Undervault triggers the awakening of an ancient guardian construct. The Archivist appears for the only time in the game as an active NPC. The lore reveal recontextualizes the entire main story.
The Dawnrider clan hosts a cross-desert racing event open to all factions. Vehicles, augmented runners, and mounted creatures all compete. Cheating is allowed. Getting caught is not.

Trigger_Condition: Netrunner activity exceeds threshold in REG012
Lore_Notes: When too many Netrunners access the Digital Sprawl simultaneously, the layer destabilizes, creating rare high-value data nodes and corrupted zones with powerful AI defenders. ORACLE-9 briefly becomes fully communicative during surges.

Trigger_Condition: Ironveil faction rep Hostile OR main questline Chapter 4
Lore_Notes: The Ironveil Empire blockades Port Mira's harbor, demanding the Merchant Guilds cut ties with Republic factions. Players must negotiate, fight through, or smuggle past the blockade. Guild and Empire reputation affected permanently.

Root Covenant members gather the season's harvest of rare botanical resources. Outsiders may help for reputation rewards. Hostile factions that attempt to steal during the Harvest trigger a faction war event chain.

Trigger_Condition: EchoID app active + Ghost career or Phantom Bureau rep Friendly+
Lore_Notes: The Phantom Bureau deploys a hidden target in the Citadel. Only players with EchoID active and sufficient rep can detect the target. First player to identify and report them receives full reward. Target identity changes each spawn.
Port Mira commemorates the end of the Merchant Wars with a festival of trade, combat exhibitions, and historical reenactments. Rare legacy module blueprints become available for the duration.

Trigger_Condition: Complete Void Walker questline Chapter 3 + Sable's Arc
Lore_Notes: Sable reveals that the Void Rift is expanding faster than anyone has publicly acknowledged. Players must gather representatives from all major factions for an unprecedented cooperation mission. The Miraverse's future depends on the outcome.

The Empire briefly lifts access restrictions to the Amber Wastes for sanctioned scavenging. Toxic exposure is still lethal without protection. Players race to collect the most salvage before the gate closes again.

Trigger_Condition: Wind pattern change — 15% chance per 12 hours
Lore_Notes: The Floating Isles shift their position relative to the ground regions, occasionally drifting over inaccessible zones and revealing temporary drop points. Sky pirates take advantage. Pathfinder career players get 2-hour advance notice.

Trigger_Condition: Discover Biolabs District + Voss questline Chapter 2
Lore_Notes: A containment failure in the Voss Collective's deepest lab level releases experimental bio-digital entities. Players must contain the breach before it spreads to the Citadel above. Dr. Voss is directly implicated in the incident.

The Ironclaw Brotherhood's combat excellence tournament. Open to all careers but heavily favors physical combat builds. Kael Ironclaw personally fights the bracket winner — the only reliable way to unlock his personal questline.

When a new shipwreck is detected off the Mirror Coast, factions race to be first to the salvage site. Deepkeel divers have home advantage. Players can hire, sabotage, or race independently to claim the highest-value cargo.
